verdict.rationale: Termius offers an AI feature that converts plain-language descriptions into shell commands, which is a form of AI-generated suggestion, but there is no evidence of AI analyzing session logs, keychain, or other in-product data to surface insights or recommendations. Missing for 10: AI-driven analysis of stored logs/session history for insights, proactive suggestions based on user data patterns, independent corroboration of the AI command feature's usefulness.
